episodes.synopsis: Ao-chan isn't interested in romance or boys — which is ironic, because a certain handsome classmates of hers is very interested in Ao-chan.
episodes.title: Ao-chan Can't Enjoy Her Youth

episodes.synopsis: Ao-chan overhears a distressing rumor about Kijima's, um... talent? Assets? Euphemisms are hard and Ao-chan is in quite a predicament, that’s for sure...
episodes.title: Ao-chan Can't Easily Decline

episodes.synopsis: When an oblivious Ao-chan suffers from a wardrobe malfunction, it's up to Kijima to save the day… except he has no idea how to fix it without looking like a total perv!
episodes.title: Ao-chan Can't Protect Her Lower Half

episodes.synopsis: Ao-chan receives a disturbing photograph of Kijima in a compromising position! Is this all a big misunderstanding, or is Kijima just as depraved as she suspects?
episodes.title: Miyabi-chan Can't Be Beaten

episodes.synopsis: Kijima's startling confession gives Ao-chan quite a shock... and the upper hand over Kijima, too. Mwa-ha-ha!
episodes.title: Ao-chan Can't Lead Virgins

episodes.synopsis: With a deadline looming, Ao-chan joins her father's editor on a research mission at... a "Love!Meat" festival? Just what kind of research is Ao supposed to be doing?!
episodes.title: Kijima-kun Can't Wait Any Longer

episodes.synopsis: Ao-chan WILL improve her grades, and to prove her dedication, she arrives three hours early for a study group near the beach. Three guesses who she unexpectedly runs into.
episodes.title: Ao-chan Can Handle the Beach

episodes.synopsis: Ao-chan thinks she knows exactly what's wrong with Kijima, and she's concocted a clever plan to remedy the situation. But then her dad decides to lend a helping hand...
episodes.title: Kijima-kun Lacks Stamina

episodes.synopsis: Ao-chan feels weird after ending things with Kijima, but it was the right thing to do. She needs to study! ...but if studying is right for her, why can't she focus?!
episodes.title: Ao-chan Needs More Than Fantasies

episodes.synopsis: Ao-chan wants to participate in her school's sports festival... and so does her father. But with Kijima cheering from the sidelines, Ao can't risk her dad messing things up!
episodes.title: Dad Can't Offer Support

episodes.synopsis: Ao-chan has a package delivered. That is not a double entendre. She literally orders something off the internet and a panic spiral ensues.
episodes.title: Ao-chan Can't Wear Silky Panties

episodes.synopsis: Ao-chan knows how take her relationship with Kijima to the next level... but it would mean breaking a promise she made to Kijima.
episodes.title: Ao-chan Can't Study
